entries.86d1387c6493387a: This division covers meat processing and sales, merchandise sales and real estate leasing. Tatebe Shokuniku Sangyo Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, processes and sells meat. Division sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,500 million, and this amount includes sales of “Karashige.”
entries.9c7a566a8bca3703: Headquartered in Showa-ku, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture, the company forms a group together with one consolidated subsidiary, Tatebe Shokuniku Sangyo Co., Ltd. The business consists almost entirely of restaurant operations as a single segment, and as of March 31, 2026, the company had 189 stores and 1,364 consolidated employees. It operates processing plants in Obu, Aichi Prefecture, and Chiba, Chiba Prefecture.
